heroSectionData.subheading2: Adding the missing piece to the problem
heroSectionData.para1: Staff augmentation is a type of outsourcing that is used to staff a project and meet the company’s goals. The method entails assessing current personnel and identifying which extra skills are necessary.

staffAugmentationSection.heading1: Staff augmentation with highly transparent teams

staffAugmentationCards.heading: Full-service development
staffAugmentationCards.content: This model implies access to a dedicated offshore development center specifically set up for your project. It lets the client fully oversee team selection and manage communication in a process that’s transparent.

staffAugmentationCards.heading: In-house team augmentation
staffAugmentationCards.content: Our organization can help you get the most out of your in-house resources by supplementing your team with engineering, testing, and support experts.

staffAugmentationCards.heading: DevOps  enablement
staffAugmentationCards.content: We engage our DevOps team to efficiently build, test, ship, run and monitor IT assets and deliver scalable products faster and with minimum hold-ups.

MediaSection.title: Personnel paired with good infrastructure and software
MediaSection.description: Teams are an integral joining point between infrastructure and software. Hence, it becomes highly important that the team working on a certain project is fully equipped to handle the challenges related to it.
